drivers.theme: Oil's fourth straight decline / Iran diplomacy hopes
Hawkish Fed resuming hikes; 'reduce demand', not painless
Broadening earnings revisions, AI capex durability
Record diesel/gasoline, sticky inflation, strained low-end consumer
US-China AI dialogue, summit week optimism
Diesel export ban risk (35%) and midterm politics

parsed.rationale: Futures up ~1% on a fourth oil slide and diplomacy hopes, with bond yields easing, buy the relief rally. But the Fed is openly hiking into a supply shock and calling for demand destruction, capping upside. Modest positive drift, heavy event risk into the Trump-Xi summit.
